Title: a conventional commit line, such as `fix(status): ...` or `docs: ...`.
It becomes the commit message when this is squash-merged.
-->

## What and why

<!--
One or two sentences: what changes, and what it fixes or makes possible for
someone using Fourmee. Link the issue, for example `Fixes #123`.
-->

## How to review

<!--
Help a reviewer spend their attention well.
- Where to start, if the change has a core file or an order to read in.
- What deserves the closest look, and anything you are unsure about.
- What to skim: renames, moved code and regenerated files are mechanical.
- What is deliberately left out, so nobody asks for it.
-->

## How to try it

<!--
Steps or commands a reviewer can run to see it work, and what they should see.
Show a result. Passing checks are already visible on this page.
-->

## Does it earn its place?

<!--
A rule stays only if removing it measurably degrades results.
- Adding or changing a rule: what goes wrong without it?
- Removing one: what did you check to be sure nothing breaks?
- Changing something people depend on, such as a task field, a script's output,
  a variable or a name: who has to change what, and is it recorded in
  CHANGELOG.md?
-->
